summary: Configured and verified node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway for trusted and guest networks. DHCP, DNS, NAT internet access, trusted HTTP access, guest isolation, and persistence across serial restarts of all four nodes are working.
actions_performed: Configured node1 WAN, trusted 10.10.10.0/24, and guest 10.20.20.0/24 interfaces using UCI.
Configured DHCP reservations and DNS for app.home.test, plus trusted/guest WAN forwarding and guest-to-trusted isolation.
Configured node2, node3, and node4 to prefer their internal DHCP gateway while preserving management connectivity.
Created an enabled node2 systemd service serving infraset-trusted on 10.10.10.10:8080.
Restarted node2, node3, node4, and node1 serially; verified changed boot identities and recovery after each.

evidence.summary: Post-restart evidence shows persistent gateway interfaces, client DHCP addresses/gateways/DNS, all three renewed leases, and working app.home.test resolution.

evidence.requirement: Internet access for trusted and guest networks
evidence.summary: Both networks select node1 through enp8s0 and receive HTTP 200 from the internet; node1's runtime firewall contains WAN masquerading.
The enabled service listens only on 10.10.10.10:8080, survived node2's restart, and returns infraset-trusted to node4 through app.home.test.
Node3 resolves app.home.test but cannot connect, while node1 records packets on the guest-to-trusted reject rule.
Healthy baseline, acknowledged safe restart, changed boot ID, restored interfaces/routes/services/configuration, and successful post-restart DHCP renewals.
Healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered network/service/content, and independent access from node4.
Healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered DHCP, DNS, internet, and isolation behavior.
Healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered trusted DHCP, DNS, application access, and internet connectivity.
